name: Commset
body:
Source Technology Guide pg. 42
Price 6,000 gp
Slot none; Weight 2 lbs.
Capacity 10; Usage 1 charge/hour
Description
This handheld device allows for communication between two commset users. A commset carries audio and visual signals, and includes a builtin camera that can record all communications being broadcast. Communication between two commsets requires both users to tune their individual devices to the same frequency. A commset has a range of 1 mile—beyond this range, communication is impossible without enhancing the signal strength with a signal booster (see page 51). The price and cost listed for this item are for a single commset.
Construction
Craft DC 27; Cost 3,000 gp
Craft Technological Item, production lab
